User Story: As a passenger, I want to search flights by route and date so that I can choose a suitable journey.
As a passenger, I want to retrieve my booking using a reference and surname so that I can check in.
As a passenger, I want to review and confirm my details so that my boarding pass is accurate.
As a passenger, I want to select an available seat so that I can sit where I prefer.
As a passenger, I want to pay for a seat upgrade so that I can access a preferred seat.
As a passenger, I want to see the payment result so that I know whether my upgrade was purchased.
As a passenger, I want to download my boarding pass so that I can present it at the airport.
As a passenger, I want my boarding pass emailed to me so that I can access it later.
As a passenger, I want to view my check-in status so that I know whether I am checked in.
As a passenger, I want to change my seat before check-in closes so that I can adjust my preference.
As a passenger, I want to see the total upgrade price before paying so that I can make an informed decision.
As a passenger, I want to retry a failed upgrade payment safely so that I can complete the purchase without duplicate charges.
